title: Acid Tar Pit
description: A low FM sub/808 voice that starts clean and deep, then a slow degradation arc ramps the bitcrush down to a few bits while the FM index climbs into screaming, metallic overtones. Over 16 cycles the coarse downsampler grits up and a ladder filter screams open before the loop resets.
code:
setcpm(132/4)
stack(
  note("<f1 f1 [f1 c1] <ab0 db1>>*2").s("sine")
    .fm(sine.slow(16).range(2, 13)).fmh("<1 1.5 2 0.5>/4")
    .penv("<0 0 12 -7>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.07)
    .crush(saw.slow(16).range(16, 3))
    .coarse("<1 1 2 4 8>/2".add(perlin.range(0, 2)))
    .distort(sine.slow(24).range(0.1, 0.9))
    .lpf(sine.slow(32).range(220, 3200)).resonance(15).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(4).lpattack(0.005).lpdecay(0.16)
    .attack(0.004).decay(0.22).sustain(0.55).release(0.06)
    .vib("<3 5 8>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.1, 1.2))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.22).pan(0.8).crush(4))
    .room(0.12).gain(0.9)
)
